method: C3 repair persistence of arm-L checker refusals; codes ranked by repeated refusals, then persistence, then refused rounds; row text: the code's generic, ticket-neutral row

rows.mistake: accessible() needs rows of a table with an owner column; the profile declares none for <Table>, so its rows are shared
rows.fix: if each <Table> row belongs to the user in its <owner column>, declare it in profile.py: add owner='<owner column>' to <Table>'s Schema.from_pairs(...) (then every endpoint that returns or writes its rows filters them with accessible(..., by=user)); otherwise drop accessible()

rows.mistake: each statement must call exactly one table op or step (or bind a constant that uses no columns)
rows.fix: split it into one op per statement, e.g. '<name> = derive(<table>, <new_col>=...)'

rows.mistake: col("<column>") has no input rows here (insert() values, constants and call() arguments read no table)
rows.fix: read the value of the one row that holds it: <row>.<column>

rows.mistake: '<name>' is a table, not a value
rows.fix: reference a column with col("<column>"); pass tables to ops by name
